title: Decode: small-op fusion, SP collectives, drafter tail
shape: D3-32 r24: 96 requests / DP rank (384 verify rows, 96 SP shard rows per GPU), L~135K, k=3
basis: baseline: gap512 EP16 in-step profile B92 (r23) exposed: AttnRes 0.50, SiTU 0.33, latent norm 0.26, MegaMoE prepare 0.22, router top-k 0.21, SP RS 0.99, SP AG 0.69, drafter+final 0.89 ms. Achievable: rhea1n model_rows B96_L135K (attnres 0.147 + router topk/latent norm/shared act 0.006 + SP AG+RS 1.28 + drafter/final tail ~0.39 ms). current_ms PROJECTED: baseline minus the measured r24 SP-boundary chain saving (0.49 ms/step, 4-GPU chain bench); step A/B pending.
gap_analysis: Per decoder layer the SP step runs 4 standalone latency-bound kernels between the attention o-projection and the MLP GEMMs: stock attn_res pre (~3-6 us), SpAllGather (7.8 us), SpReduceScatter with push (7.9 us), stock attn_res post. The model charges AG/RS at the Lamport floor and AttnRes as a ~0.75 us memory pass; the measured excess is kernel boundaries + the stock AttnRes using only n of the SMs (one row per CTA). The SP path also keeps SiTU-and-mul, the latent RMSNorm, the router grouped top-k and the MegaMoE prepare as separate kernels (2-4 us each, 92 layers). Re-measuring at the D3-32 per-GPU shape (n=96) on Rhea first.
inefficiencies: AttnRes pre/post as standalone stock kernels (one row per CTA; 96 of the SMs busy at n=96) (measured gap512)
SP all-gather and reduce-scatter as separate kernels from the AttnRes they feed / follow (2 extra boundaries per layer)
R>64 o-proj partial pushed by a separate pass inside the RS kernel (re-reads the partial)
SiTU-and-mul, latent RMSNorm, router grouped top-k, MegaMoE prepare unfused (92 layers x 4 kernels)
Drafter tail: NCCL ring AllGather (75 us) for the final aux gather, unfused ArNorm/GQA window kernels (hypothesis pending profile)
plan: Measure the SP layer-boundary chain (AttnRes pre/post + AG + RS) at n=4/32/96 on 4 GPUs (bench_kimi_k3_sdec_sp_chain.py)
K1: fuse pre-AttnRes + SP all-gather (cluster AttnRes publishing its output rows by multicast, polling the gathered rows)

K2: fuse SP reduce-scatter owner sum + post-AttnRes (cluster AttnRes reading the TP recv slots as its Lamport delta ring, re-arming slots + gather rows); push from the o-proj epilogue (with D-GEMM) or inside K2
Router GEMM + grouped top-k + MegaMoE prepare as one kernel (coordinate with D-GEMM/D-MOE)
SiTU-and-mul (+MXFP8 quant for NVFP4) into the shared gate_up epilogue (with D-GEMM); latent RMSNorm into the combine / latent_up path
Drafter tail: replace the NCCL final AG by the SP multicast gather; fuse tail kernels
